rationale: Reuters poll Oct 5-8: 70 of 73 economists expect a hold at 2.50% on Oct 29, with a hike expected in December; Goldman also sees December. Upside risk from 3.8% September inflation keeps it off the extreme. A search result displayed market-implied odds; ignored.
No precedent or credible signal of demolition of the Dome of the Rock; Israel holds elections Oct 27, so the term is nearly over. Base rate essentially zero.

Blockade reinstated July 13 and CENTCOM is touting its costs on Iran as of Oct 16; Trump says no talks while Iran-Oman talks proceed. A formal, unambiguous announcement ending the blockade within six weeks requires a deal breakthrough; some chance of a post-midterm deal.

Requires a formal US-Iran Hormuz agreement announced by Nov 2 (about 2 weeks) with IRGC attacking shipping and no direct US talks; I put that near 6%. Senate D control is around 55-75% in non-market forecasts (DDHQ 56%, Silver 75%). Product about 4%.

SNS-led lists have topped every Serbian election since 2012 and control media and state resources; Faktor Plus (Sept) shows United Serbia 48.6 vs Student List 37.1, though CRTA (June) had the students ahead. Polls are contested and the student movement is strong, so meaningful upset risk. A search snippet showed a market price; ignored.

Reporting says Trump has paused strikes on Iran during midterm season, and US actions recently hit tankers at sea rather than Iranian land. But the conflict is active (IRGC hitting ships, Trump threatening nuclear sites), and the window runs 12 days past the Nov 3 election, when the pause rationale lapses. Roughly 60% no qualifying strike.

Recent polls put Likud at 18-22 (10-poll average about 22, Maariv 18), with only Channel 14/i24 outliers at 26-29. Hitting 25-29 needs a 3+ seat polling miss in Likud's favor, which has happened historically but is not the base case.

Special election is happening Nov 3; Republican Ashley Moody leads Democrat Angie Nixon by about 5-7 in averages (Stetson +11, Mason-Dixon +10, St. Pete +2). Florida's recent R lean outweighs a Democratic-leaning national environment.

A nationwide injunction blocks the USPS rule for the Nov 3 election; the First Circuit upheld it and the Supreme Court declined to lift it on Sept 14, with Kavanaugh saying it is too late for the midterms. Little room for reversal with about 2 weeks left.

Google just shipped Gemini 4 Argon (Oct 13), which is not Pro-labeled; the newest Pro remains 3.1 Pro. A Pro-labeled public release in the next 2 weeks right after a flagship launch is possible (rumors of Gemini 4 Pro in October) but unlikely.

Wilson leads the GOP field but trails Democrat Kreiss-Tomkins in every recent poll (Cygnal 44-24 first round; ASR Oct 1-3 RCV final 54-46; AARP RCV +10), and Cook shifted the race toward Democrats. Alaska's R lean and RCV transfers give her a real but minority chance.

Only medical/FDA-approved marijuana moved to Schedule III (April 2026), which does not remove criminal penalties for personal possession; broader rescheduling still pending and would also not decriminalize. No such law or action plausible by Nov 3.
